item.text:
{"brief":"The user prefers science fiction, particularly movies about the future and space battles, and is a strong Star Trek fan. One of their favorite movies is the original 1977 Star Wars, A New Hope. They saw it as a child, and it introduced them to fantasy and science fiction.

They liked Inception a lot, praising its direction, acting, story, pacing, and the “shocker at the end.” They thought it was well done overall.

They dislike romance, family-oriented movies, and musicals. They agreed when asked whether these were too boring, explaining that they simply do not interest them.

They have heard of The Happytime Murders but have not seen it and expressed no opinion about its appeal."}
